A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] individual was a '''member''' of [[Grey Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] unit led by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X2]]. At some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Mon Calamari accompanied X2 and the rest of Grey Squadron on a [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, the Mon Calamari assisted X2 in clearing out the [[X1's Dathomir base|base]] that had once belonged to X2's brother, [[X1]].<ref name="Elite Squadron" />
